### Fixed
- **Uninstalling the platform through a cluster's own Flux no longer races the Substrate CRD chart** (giantswarm/agent-platform#385). With the engine off nothing orders the component uninstalls — helm-controller finalizes the platform `HelmRelease`s the chart rendered concurrently — and `substrate-crds` could go before `substrate`, whose uninstall then failed for good on its `SandboxConfig` (`failed to delete release: substrate`: Helm cannot delete an object whose kind is gone) and was retried until the meta `HelmRelease`'s finalizer timed out (measured on the ATS own-Flux scenario, PR #380). The Substrate line re-pins to **`v0.0.27-gs.3`** (`components.substrate`/`substrate-crds` `>=0.0.27-gs.3 <0.0.28-0`, `kagent.substrateWorkerPool.workerImage` `0.0.27-gs.3`, `examples/customer-bom.yaml`, `tests/verify-components.py`): its one new carried patch (giantswarm/substrate#12, upstream-first, prepared for kagent-dev/substrate in giantswarm/giantswarm#37742 row 28) puts `helm.sh/resource-policy: keep` on the three `ate.dev` CRD templates, set at the generator as the kagent line does (giantswarm/kagent-upstream#10) — so every CRD chart of the platform keeps its CRDs and a consumer's uninstall can always delete its CRs, whatever order the releases go in. The ATS own-Flux scenario's way back is a test now (`test_the_way_back_uninstalls_through_the_clusters_flux`): the meta `HelmRelease` deleted, every platform release uninstalled concurrently by the cluster's Flux with no `UninstallFailed`, the eight kept CRDs in place, no `SandboxConfig` or `WorkerPool` left — the `delete_platform_releases_in_waves` workaround is gone; the smoke's ordered teardown asserts the same keep policy on `ate.dev`. Rejected: rendering the `teardown-releases` hook with the engine off (a `cluster-admin` hook in the fleet render for an order that stops mattering) and waiting for a Flux-side reverse-`dependsOn` uninstall (upstream's open fluxcd/flux2#1744). README "Clusters that run Flux", "Uninstalling", "CRD lifecycle" and `UPGRADE.md` describe the uninstall order and what a kept CRD implies. **No installation acts** — the release stays inert behind the fleet's `<4.0.0` bound.
